items: Vertical 9:16 portrait format photograph. In a bright kitchen with a white counter and a window, the palm of a hand pressing down and rolling a whole yellow lemon firmly on the counter, a second lemon cut in half with glistening pulp beside it, close-up from slightly above. Photorealistic, soft daylight, rolled-up sleeve of a navy-blue cotton shirt, no face visible. No text, no letters, no numbers, no brand names, no logos, no watermark.
